component.name: Tinta
component.summary: A code editor that looks at home on GNOME and on COSMIC
Um editor de código com a cara do GNOME e do COSMIC

description.p: A fast code editor written in Rust, in the style of the COSMIC™ desktop, with the features you would expect from Visual Studio Code and Sublime Text.

ul.li: Syntax highlighting for 220 grammars, with 14 color themes
Multiple cursors, column selection, code folding, minimap, sticky scroll
Language servers: completion, hover, go to definition, rename, formatting, quick fixes
Find and replace with regular expressions, in the file or across a folder
Git: changes in the gutter, staging, commits, push and pull, blame
Command palette, quick open, splits, an integrated terminal, Markdown preview
